content.short: HeyMint Launchpad lets you launch an NFT project in minutes with no coding.
content.description: HeyMint Launchpad lets you start an NFT project in minutes without any technical knowledge. Its NFT art generator helps you create your collection, and the guided workflow makes it easy to design the smart contract you need. Configure presale, public sale, and a custom mint button, then generate your contract in seconds — all for free. From artwork creation to custom contracts and mint buttons, HeyMint Launchpad provides a complete end-to-end solution so you can launch quickly and focus on your mint.
